annotation_definition: Invented compact action-plan summaries authored from each pre-action visible prefix and proposed next action; not private or recovered model reasoning.
annotation_order: Each task processed in prefix order; the plan for each action was recorded before later prefixes for that task were opened.
immutability: Created with exclusive-write mode; content frozen under recorded hashes. Do not overwrite or rebase; publish any revisions separately.

length_check.lexical_unit_count_definition: Unicode word runs plus individual non-whitespace punctuation

provenance_caveats: 15 recovery annotations remain bound to pilot-20261001-003 and its recorded source hash. Parent reported a provenance issue. Do not rebase them onto corrected receipts or admit them to SFT.
3 CLI pilot_v3 annotations are diagnostic and require separate admission before training use.
All source splits are retained; this mixed-split pilot must not be treated as a training file.

validation.scope: Packet message structure only; source trace correctness and execution provenance were not independently verified.
